name: The particle
definition: A word whose meaning only appears together with another word; it is neither a noun nor a verb.
body: فِي (in), مِنْ (from), لَمْ (did not) and هَلْ (is it?) are particles. فِي on its own says little; فِي البَيْتِ (in the house) is clear.
Al-Ājurrūmiyya defines the particle by what it lacks: it takes none of the signs of the noun or of the verb. Many particles govern: they put a noun into khafḍ, or a verb into naṣb or jazm.

examples.text: fī l-bayti, in the house: fī puts al-bayt into khafḍ.
lam yadhhab, he did not go: lam puts the verb into jazm.
